documents.title: What is LawSynth?
documents.text: LawSynth turns multivariate time series into typed equations, causal hypotheses, regimes, uncertainty, and simulations expressed as a World IR.

documents.title: Quickstart
documents.text: Install the LawSynth CLI and discover your first world from a CSV in under five minutes.

documents.title: World IR
documents.text: The World IR is a typed executable representation combining equations, dependency graphs, regimes, and uncertainty for a dynamical system.
